title: OnJoinTP
description: A Minecraft Plugin that teleports a player on Server join
body:
# OnJoinTP | Simple Spawn Management
**OnJoinTP** is a lightweight and efficient utility plugin designed to give you full control over where players land when they join your server. Whether you want a consistent lobby experience or a specific starting point for new adventures, this plugin has you covered.

## ✨ Main Features
- Auto-Teleport: Automatically sends players to a designated spawn point the moment they join the server.
- Player Toggle: Players with specific permissions can choose to opt-out of the teleportation if they prefer to stay where they logged off.
- Easy Setup: Set your server's spawn point in-game with a single command.

## 💻 Commands & Permissions

- `/setspawn`
- `/onjointp reload`
- `/onjointp toggle`

**permissions:**

-   **onjointp.reload:**
  
    description: Allow reloading of the config
     
    default: op

-   **onjointp.toggle:**
 
    description: Allow toggle of Join-TP
  
     default: op

-   **onjointp.setspawn:**
  
     description: Allow to set Server spawn
  
     default: op

  
**Note**: You can use the shorthand alias /ojtp for all onjointp commands!

## 🛠️ Configuration
The plugin is designed to be "plug and play." Once installed, simply go to your desired spawn location and type `/setspawn`. Everything else works out of the box!

**Requirements**:
- Compatible with Spigot / Paper / Purpur.
- Version: 1.21.X (Other versions have not yet been tested).
